whatIs.title: What Is Hydrolipoclasia?
whatIs.p1: Hydrolipoclasia is a non-invasive body contouring treatment designed to help reduce localized fat and improve body contours through specialized protocols that combine different aesthetic technologies and techniques.
whatIs.p2: This treatment is commonly used on areas where fat tends to accumulate and may be difficult to reduce through diet and exercise alone.
whatIs.important: Hydrolipoclasia can complement healthy habits and body wellness programs, but it is important to understand that:
importantItems: It does not replace healthy lifestyle habits

items.q: Does it help with weight loss?
items.a: It is designed to help improve areas with localized fat and body contours. It does not replace medical weight-loss programs or treatments.
Changes are generally progressive and can depend on lifestyle habits, the number of sessions, and your body's individual response.

items.q: Can I exercise after the treatment?
items.a: In many cases, yes. However, recommendations may vary depending on your individual assessment and the protocol performed.
The abdomen, waist, flanks, back, arms, legs, lower back, and other areas may be treated depending on your individual assessment.
